draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise perturbation experiments. Only original-label results (T1) are reported; the robustness criterion and noise-aware loss are described but never tested. No evidence supports any claim about robustness to label noise.

judgement.proposition: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in training annotations
judgement.expressed_strength: "appears somewhat robust" — hedged claim of robustness to label noise
judgement.strongest_supported: No evidence in the package evaluates Thornbill-NER under label-noise conditions; the package only reports performance on original labels.
